shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile with open jaws / bared teeth
predatory feline-like beast with heavy limbs
depiction of animals as the sole subject matter
justification: Both depict a heavy-bodied predatory quadruped shown in profile with an emphatically open, toothed mouth and stiff forelimbs, a fairly specific shared motif of a snarling beast. But A is a single free-standing animal figure with no context, whereas B is a multi-register composition combining several different creatures (birds, a crouching quadruped, a fox-like animal) with abstract bands and repeated arcaded signs, so the relationships and arrangement have almost nothing in common.
